canonical_candidates.name: Registered adaptive perspective scheduler
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Keep five perspectives as a versioned multi-label taxonomy and all-five fallback; deterministic tags plus an LLM planner select a protected core and zero-or-more registered optional specialists, record run/skip/defer reasons, then optionally revise once after partial/runtime evidence.

canonical_candidates.name: Contract-bound supplemental diagnostic lens
canonical_candidates.mechanism: When registered perspectives leave a typed evidence gap, generate one ephemeral lens/checklist mapped to an existing root-cause taxonomy and Finding schema; no autonomous role creation.

canonical_candidates.name: Evidence-cited semantic critic
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Trigger one independent challenge pass only for High/Critical, cross-perspective disagreement, or weak evidence; critic must cite code/evidence and may reject, abstain, or request a probe, never confirm.

canonical_candidates.name: Hypothesis-discriminating ephemeral probe
canonical_candidates.mechanism: For a specific finding, LLM proposes precondition, minimal input/action, expected support/refute observations, independent oracle, cleanup, and leak checks; sandbox executor validates candidate evidence; generated tests never become gold automatically.

canonical_candidates.name: RuntimeEvidence-conditioned one-time revision
canonical_candidates.mechanism: After a focused test/profile completes, rerun only the affected perspective once to revise root cause, severity, or disposition using immutable evidence.

canonical_candidates.name: Offline feedback failure localizer
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Periodically cluster evaluator-confirmed misses/false positives and attribute likely failure to retrieval, graph resolution, planner, specialist, merge, router, or gate; propose versioned changes behind frozen regression and human promotion.

canonical_candidates.name: Adaptive evidence aperture
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Use partial trajectory/evidence gaps to choose relation types, code granularity, bounded 1/2-hop expansion, and optional history/trace retrieval; no unrestricted long-term memory.

canonical_candidates.name: Read-only trace/log reasoning adapter
canonical_candidates.mechanism: If project telemetry exists, retrieve bounded redacted OpenTelemetry/log spans and let an affected specialist compare runtime path with Code Graph hypotheses; immutable provenance required.

canonical_candidates.name: Learned model/specialist router
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Train or calibrate a router from project utility labels to choose specialist/model per case; shadow mode and rollback required.

canonical_candidates.name: Unrestricted debate/reflection swarm
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Multiple homogeneous agents repeatedly debate/refine until consensus or confidence threshold.

canonical_candidates.name: Free-form persistent agent memory
canonical_candidates.mechanism: Store prior analyses as unconstrained semantic memory and retrieve them automatically in later cases.

canonical_candidates.name: Semgrep/static corroboration adapter
canonical_candidates.mechanism: LLM selects a narrow diff/rule scope; deterministic Semgrep output becomes additional static evidence. Supporting engineering, not a new AI reasoning layer.

Common contract for every arm: use only the existing pilot/train/calibration/regression assets; never inspect or tune on final-temporal/final-OOD manifests or labels. Every added planner, lens, critic, retrieval summary, test-generation, retry, gate and composer call consumes the same inclusive B_run; tool seconds also stay under the frozen arm cap. Preserve failures, timeouts, abstentions and budget overruns; mark overruns non_comparable rather than deleting them. Tune thresholds on train/calibration, select versions on regression, and only a finally frozen winner may be run once on each final holdout under the existing one_run_record contract.

scores.reason: Local design evidence (docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md §§2,7; AG-C2/ACT-C1) confirms that the planner always dispatches five first-pass views and lacks run/skip/defer contracts. SWE-Router (2026-06-30) supports partial-trajectory routing as a cost-quality mechanism, but it routes models on SWE tasks, not Python diagnostic perspectives. This is strong Lv3 orchestration, yet its expected diagnosis result is mainly recall preservation while saving calls, not a demonstrated quality gain.
scores.evidence_gap: No paired Python defect-diagnosis result yet shows that skipping perspectives preserves per-perspective and Critical/High recall, especially for rare concurrency/performance defects.

scores.reason: EXP-C2/C3 and the artifact-gap track find no recent direct code-diagnosis evidence for generated lenses and recommend routing registered perspectives first; they also identify duplicate findings, taxonomy drift, and schema mismatch as the likely outcomes. A contract-bound lens is more disciplined than free-form role creation, but novelty of wording is not causal diagnostic value.
scores.evidence_gap: Needs an evaluator-owned taxonomy-tail cohort showing unique accepted true findings per token over a budget-matched replay of an existing perspective, with low duplication and grounding errors.

scores.reason: Adversarial Review (2026-08-16; PF-C5) reports SWE-PRBench F1 rising from 0.457 to 0.533 when disagreement is evidence-constrained, while naive critic/reviewer interaction can create false consensus; its SWE-bench arm also cost about 4.5x tokens. A single challenge-only pass that can reject, abstain, or request a probe therefore has plausible precision/severity value and clear Lv3 evidence discipline without adding another voting agent.
scores.evidence_gap: Must show incremental value over the existing merger/Evidence Gate under the same B_run, including TP false-retraction and Critical/High recall; same-family error correlation remains unmeasured.

scores.reason: ACT-C4/AG-C4 show a concrete local gap: focused-test requests record commands but not the hypothesis, predicted support/refute observations, or independent oracle. The 2026 LLM counterexample study (ACT-C5) improved Java assertion precision from 67.83% to 74.17% only by accepting compiling/executed witnesses, while REAP requires relevance and multi-run stability. Translating a Python diagnosis into one falsifiable, sandboxed probe is the clearest causal quality improvement and strongest Lv3 demonstration.
scores.evidence_gap: No project data yet establishes pytest probe relevance, independent-oracle rate, differential validity, flakiness, or safe execution on Python 3.14 repositories; the strongest outcome evidence is from Java specification inference, not Python diagnosis.

scores.reason: PF-C4 cites SWE-Adept and PerfAgent as recent evidence that test/profile feedback should update the next analysis rather than drive blind repetition; PerfAgent reports better optimization metrics than blind best-of-five at lower cost, although in patch/optimization workflows. Reusing the existing specialist exactly once with immutable RuntimeEvidence is a small, causally coherent way to correct root cause, severity, or disposition.
scores.evidence_gap: Needs a diagnosis-only paired test proving that revision improves gold status transitions and causal accuracy beyond what the deterministic Evidence Gate already achieves, without overfitting to an unrepresentative workload.

scores.reason: AG-C5 documents a real lifecycle gap between versioned FeedbackEvents/regression promotion and attribution of failures to retrieval, graph resolution, planner, specialist, merge, router, or gate. That is meaningful Lv3 meta-diagnosis, but its only non-local inspiration is a secondary Uber transcript; there is no primary evidence that an LLM localizer improves Python findings, and its benefit is indirect and delayed.
scores.evidence_gap: Requires a hidden attribution set with known subsystem causes and evidence that promoted, versioned changes improve frozen regressions without new Critical/High regressions or holdout leakage.

scores.reason: The 500-instance Python SWE-bench localization study in ACT-C3 found file context important and expanded line context often noisy, supporting adaptive granularity. However, it used ground-truth buggy locations and measured repair success, while the current exact/BM25/vector plus bounded 1/2-hop design already supplies a conservative aperture. The incremental diagnosis gain is plausible but not isolated from A1 routing.
scores.evidence_gap: Needs noisy-anchor, diagnosis-only ablation showing localization Recall and Critical/High recall non-inferiority plus lower evidence tokens, especially on cross-file and dynamic-dispatch cases; test only after A1 is frozen.

scores.reason: ECO-04 verifies that Grafana MCP v1.1.0 exposes bounded Loki/Tempo/Sift log and slow-request evidence, which could materially improve async/performance root-cause localization when representative telemetry already exists. But this is capability evidence, not diagnosis-quality evidence; local RuntimeEvidence currently accepts only profile/test, so provenance, redaction, RBAC, schema, and workload representativeness add substantial risk and engineering.
scores.evidence_gap: No eligible telemetry inventory or incident cohort shows unique accepted Python findings, root-cause localization lift, abstention quality, or safe redaction versus the current profiler/test path.

scores.reason: Agent-as-a-Router (SYS-C2/PF-C3) reports an execution-grounded coding router outperforming a static dimension-best router (49.98% versus 47.50% ID and 62.50% on 176 OOD tasks), so learned routing is genuine advanced AI. It nevertheless routes models, not diagnosis perspectives, and the project has neither a proven complementary model/specialist pool nor enough frozen project utility labels; selective-label feedback and version drift can lower actual diagnosis quality.
scores.evidence_gap: First collect paired outcomes for at least two stable model/specialist choices and demonstrate a material oracle gap, calibration, rare-risk coverage, and temporal/OOD robustness in shadow mode.

scores.reason: ADV-02 cites a 2026 controlled study in which unguided homogeneous debate used 2.1-3.4x the tokens of isolated self-correction while matching or reducing accuracy and exhibited conformity and minority-answer collapse. Repeating similar agents until consensus adds visible AI feature count but no evidence-grounded causal mechanism for better Python diagnosis, and it weakens the bounded DAG.
scores.evidence_gap: No direct Python diagnosis evidence shows a same-budget Pareto gain over one independent challenge pass; without such evidence there is no reason to implement it.

scores.reason: STALE (2026-05-07; ADV-04) reports that agents may act on obsolete beliefs even after retrieving updated evidence, with the best evaluated system reaching only 55.2% overall. Unconstrained cross-run semantic memory would replace the project’s commit/version/hash provenance with stale findings, poisoning and evaluator-split leakage; that is complexity without trustworthy diagnostic causality.
scores.evidence_gap: Only reconsider against versioned exact artifact retrieval on commit-update, revert, conflict, and leakage scenarios with near-zero stale-use; no such evidence exists here.

scores.reason: Official Semgrep v1.174.0/v1.173.0 evidence (ECO-01) confirms local Python/diff scans and a maintained MCP/CLI surface, making narrow deterministic corroboration easy to measure. Semgrep’s own v1.174.0 README (ECO-02) warns that Community Edition can miss cross-file true positives and tolerates false positives, so it can strengthen or contradict a finding but cannot replace the Code Graph or count as Lv3 AI reasoning.
scores.evidence_gap: Needs a frozen-rule, Python 3.14 paired ablation measuring unique valid evidence, duplicate/false-positive rate, parse failures, latency, and downstream finding changes.

scores.evidence_gap: No fresh primary source demonstrates unique, grounded defect discovery by a generated lens in repository-level Python diagnosis. The project also lacks a preregistered, evaluator-owned residual-root-cause cohort showing that registered perspectives leave a repeatable gap.

scores.reason: Fresh primary work shows an LLM generating executable counterexamples and accepting them only after execution can directly eliminate invalid hypotheses (arXiv:2604.10761v1, 2026-04-12, §§V-C–V-D, VII-A), while REAP supplies strong leakage controls—solution-diff removal, code-path relevance, and repeated stability (arXiv:2604.01527v4, 2026-07-28, §3.3). No source validates choosing relation types or 1/2-hop expansion from noisy partial trajectories, and the incremental benefit over the existing one bounded expansion is unknown; evaluate only after A1 to avoid confounding.

scores.reason: Fresh official documentation proves the tool surface: Grafana MCP v1.1.0 exposes bounded Loki, Prometheus, Sift, and Tempo queries and permits tool-category restriction (official README/release, 2026-08-10). It does not prove that LLM trace/log reasoning improves this diagnosis system. Transfer also requires expanding RuntimeEvidence beyond profile/test and depends on pre-existing telemetry. A blinded retrospective incident comparison could be credible only with evaluator-owned time ranges and root causes, immutable provenance, redaction, read-only permissions, and the same inclusive B_run.
scores.evidence_gap: No project telemetry inventory or incident-gold cohort is established, and no cited primary outcome study measures code-diagnosis lift from this adapter. Without existing Loki/Tempo/Grafana data, the candidate is not a runnable minimal pilot and infrastructure cost dominates the evidence question.

scores.reason: Routing is technically plausible, but current evidence argues against cold-start promotion. Learning Agent Routing From Early Experience reports capability-profile prompt routing instability under paraphrase/distribution shift and greater stability only after paired outcome/runtime evidence (arXiv:2605.07180v1, 2026-05-08, §§3.1–3.2,5.4); Agent-as-a-Router concerns model routing, not project specialists (arXiv:2606.22902v1, 2026-06-22, §§3–5). Shadow mode with frozen calibration and temporal/OOD evaluation is leakage-aware, but a decisive pilot first requires a multi-model/specialist outcome matrix and counterfactual labels from routes that would otherwise be skipped.
scores.evidence_gap: The project has no demonstrated specialist/model complementarity, sufficient rare-risk labels, calibration power, or stable verifier target. Existing sources do not transfer utility scores to Python perspective routing, and selective-label bias prevents a clean same-B_run learned-router trial today.

scores.reason: Fresh controlled counterevidence directly undermines the claimed mechanism: unguided homogeneous debate consumed 2.1–3.4× the tokens while matching or underperforming isolated self-correction and exhibited majority conformity and loss of correct minority paths (arXiv:2605.00914v1, 2026-04-29, §§3.3,3.5/Table 1). Unrestricted repeated rounds also conflict with the local bounded DAG and inclusive B_run. A matched-budget negative control is measurable, but there is no evidence-grounded stopping criterion worth operationalizing.
scores.evidence_gap: The negative study uses 7–8B open models on math/knowledge reasoning rather than Python diagnosis, so it does not reject structured heterogeneous roles or one challenge pass. It does leave the unrestricted homogeneous swarm with no fresh, transferable positive evidence.

scores.reason: The most relevant fresh primary evidence is adverse: even when fresh information was retrieved, agents often failed to apply it, and the best system reached only 55.2% overall accuracy on STALE (arXiv:2605.06527v1, 2026-05-07, Abstract, §1/Table 1, §3). Unconstrained cross-run memory would discard the project's stronger commit/version/hash provenance and introduces final-holdout leakage, stale findings, persistent poisoning, deletion, and audit burdens. Exact versioned artifact retrieval remains the defensible control.
scores.evidence_gap: STALE is a conversational personalization benchmark, not repository diagnosis, but there is also no fresh primary project-transfer evidence showing that free-form memory improves downstream accepted findings. A leakage-resistant same-B_run evaluation would require versioned writes, ancestry bounds, and provenance—thereby ceasing to be the unrestricted candidate.

scores.reason: Fresh official sources strongly entail deployability: Semgrep v1.174.0 supports Python local/diff scans, and its versioned MCP/CLI documentation exposes machine-readable local execution (official release and repository docs, 2026-08-20). The same official README warns Community Edition can miss cross-file security positives, so it must corroborate rather than replace the Code Graph or Evidence Gate. A frozen-rule, narrow-scope CLI adapter supports a decisive same-B_run blinded ablation on unique accepted evidence, duplicate rate, counterevidence rejections, parse failures, and latency.
scores.evidence_gap: Official sources establish features, not defect-quality lift; Python 3.14 syntax coverage is not specifically guaranteed. Incremental evidence over the existing AST/CFG/Code Graph is unmeasured, and deterministic Semgrep is supporting engineering rather than a new AI reasoning layer.

strongest_evidence: SWE-Router (arXiv:2607.00053v1, Abstract, §§1–3, §5.3) learns a binary weak-versus-strong model escalation rule from K-step partial patch-solving trajectories on SWE-Bench; it does not choose diagnosis perspectives, measure perspective recall, or test fixed-five versus selective diagnosis under this project's inclusive B_run. Its Bayes theorem concerns an ideal Bayes-optimal decision rule, not the accuracy of a transferred scheduler.

MACA (arXiv:2605.25746v1, §§2.1–2.3, §3.1, Limitations) genuinely can filter agents and adapt interactions under a token-aware policy, so it supports generic selective orchestration. However, its six benchmarks are HumanEval, MBPP, MMLU-Pro, ARC-C, SVAMP, and GSM-Hard; it reports accuracy/average cost rather than repository-diagnosis Critical/High recall under the same inclusive B_run, and explicitly says open-ended/domain-specific generalization is unestablished and that results depend on a predefined, manually described agent pool.

AgentAbstain (arXiv:2607.10059v1, Abstract, §§1–2.2) is not a routing study. Its best agent achieves only 59.5% paired act/abstain accuracy across 263 paired tool tasks, with abstention largely independent of task-solving ability. It therefore weakens reliance on an LLM's skip/defer judgment and supports paired calibration plus deterministic guards, but does not show that perspective scheduling improves diagnosis.

The local design fixes five parallel first-pass perspectives and charges planner, analyst, gate, retries, and composer to one inclusive B_run (docs/ai-selection-matrix/04-agent-orchestration-adr.md §§2,4,7; docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md §§2,7,9). This establishes a valid control and budget contract, not inefficiency or quality lift from omitting perspectives.
adversarial_verifications.source_entailment: The sources entail only three component-level propositions: partial execution history can improve binary model routing, a learned multi-agent system can select a subset of predefined agents, and uncalibrated act/abstain decisions are unreliable. None entails that the five project perspectives are safely omissible, that registered labels make omission observable, or that a selective scheduler improves accepted diagnosis quality at equal B_run. Registration improves auditability, not recall. Therefore A1 remains a testable hypothesis, not an evidence-backed advancement, and should be held rather than advanced as the default topology.
adversarial_verifications.concrete_falsification: Kill A1 if a frozen temporal/OOD paired evaluation produces even one evaluator-adjudicated Critical/High finding that fixed-five recovers but A1 misses because it skipped or deferred the contributing perspective; also kill it if the pre-registered one-sided paired non-inferiority bound for Critical/High recall crosses the allowed margin, regardless of token savings.
transfer_limits: SWE-Router routes between model strengths for issue resolution; perspectives are multi-label causal lenses whose omission loss is not represented by its binary success reward.
SWE-Router's value head needs trajectory/reward labels; this project currently lacks counterfactual utility labels for perspectives that were not run.

MACA's HumanEval/MBPP code generation is short-form generation, not fixed-snapshot repository diagnosis, and its reported cost frontier is not a same-inclusive-B_run comparison against this five-view DAG.

MACA learns participation and interaction from accuracy rewards; the project needs rare, asymmetric Critical/High recall and unsupported-finding penalties, for which no transferred reward or calibration is supplied.

AgentAbstain concerns whether to execute a task/tool action, often with irreversible commits. It does not validate specialist omission, while its low paired accuracy is adverse evidence against free-form LLM skip decisions.
Five perspectives are non-exclusive: one defect can require performance plus concurrency or correctness plus test evidence. A one-deferred-perspective cap can miss multiple latent contributors.

Parallel fixed-five execution means fewer calls may reduce tokens/cost without materially reducing wall time; under equal B_run, any benefit depends on proving that reallocated depth beats lost breadth.
required_constraints: Keep fixed-five as the control and immediate fallback; never infer safety from low fallback frequency.
Correctness must remain protected, and deterministic signals may add mandatory perspectives; the LLM may add but must not remove mandatory routes.

Record a versioned disposition for all five registered perspectives with evidence IDs and enumerated run/skip/defer reasons; freeze taxonomy, triggers, thresholds, model, and planner before final holdout.

Fallback must cover schema/planner failure, incomplete extractor or graph coverage, OOD/unclassified inputs, and unresolved High/Critical evidence, while explicitly recognizing that fallback cannot detect a semantically wrong but schema-valid skip.
Use evaluator-owned multi-label perspective gold and evaluation-only counterfactual all-five runs on a controlled sample to expose selective-label bias and attribute route-caused false negatives.

Compare variants with the identical inclusive B_run accounting for planner, all analyst inputs/outputs, retries, merge, gate, and composer; report natural-cost separately and do not convert token savings into an unmeasured quality claim.
No online adaptation or final-holdout feedback; promote only after frozen regression, temporal/OOD evaluation, shadowing, rollback, and zero route-attributable Critical/High misses.
adversarial_verifications.decisive_experiment: Pre-register a paired F5-versus-A1 experiment on the same Python cases, commit snapshots, model/version, context, tools, and inclusive B_run. Stratify for localized correctness, structure, performance, concurrency, test gaps, multi-label cross-cutting defects, framework-magic/reflection cases, and temporal/OOD repositories; include trigger-present/trigger-absent minimal pairs. Freeze A1 before final evaluation. For attribution, run all five perspectives evaluation-only in shadow for each A1 case, without feeding omitted outputs to A1, and have blinded evaluators adjudicate gold findings and contributing perspectives. Primary endpoint: paired Critical/High recall with a pre-registered non-inferiority margin; secondary endpoints: route-attributable false negatives, per-perspective omission confusion matrix, accepted true findings per inclusive B_run, analyst tokens/calls, fallback rate, and wall time. A single route-caused Critical/High miss on final temporal/OOD, failed recall non-inferiority, or immaterial token reduction kills the proposal and retains F5.
adversarial_verifications.critical_gap: There is no project-specific counterfactual evidence for what skipped perspectives would have found, especially for rare concurrency/performance and cross-perspective Critical/High defects. A valid-looking schedule can omit the only useful lens without triggering any schema, OOD, or fallback condition, so the proposed safeguards do not close the core omission-risk loop.

strongest_evidence: The current project already includes a semantic counter-review inside the Evidence Gate: reachability, guard/cache/lock/test counterexamples, hotspot-vs-caller causality, workload representativeness, and simpler explanations; failures become rejected or abstained (docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md §11, lines 295-313). A3 therefore largely duplicates existing judging rather than adding a demonstrated capability.

Adversarial Review's naive reviewer–critic was the worst reviewed method on SWE-PRBench: F1 0.457 versus 0.495 single reviewer, 0.501 MARS, and 0.503 two reviewers. Its case studies show speculative-finding amplification and a critic yielding to an unsupported rebuttal—direct evidence that another judge can create false consensus rather than independent validation (arXiv:2608.18167v1 §4.2-4.3).

The paper's evidence-constrained prompt improved SWE-PRBench F1 to 0.533 on N=100, but this was one prompt iteration, judged by GPT-5.2, with no reported confidence interval/significance test, and no comparison against a deterministic provenance/status gate plus an existing counter-review. It supports typed disagreement as a protocol hypothesis, not superiority over this project's Evidence Gate (§4.1, §4.4-4.5, §7).

All agent/subagent calls in Adversarial Review used Claude Sonnet 4.5 Medium Reasoning. The paper does not measure reviewer–critic error correlation; its false-consensus examples and same-model self-correction discussion undermine any assumption that a fresh role prompt is an independent error source (§3.1, §4.3, §7).

AR reached 75.2% versus 71.6% zero-shot on SWE-bench Verified but used about 4.5× the tokens, and the evidence-constrained prompt was not back-ported to that run. The authors also show a scope-creep case where the loop amplified a speculative concern and failed hidden tests (§5.2-5.3, §6-7). A3's narrower conditional cost is unmeasured; under the project's inclusive B_run, its call displaces analysis budget.
adversarial_verifications.source_entailment: The primary source entails only that, on one 100-PR review benchmark, changing a reviewer–critic interaction from naive agreement/disagreement to explicit AGREE / DISAGREE_EVIDENCE / DISAGREE_CONCERN improved comment-matching F1. It does not entail that a semantic critic improves Python risk diagnosis, beats this project's already semantic Evidence Gate, contributes information beyond the merger/counter-review, has acceptably low correlated error, or is cost-effective under the same inclusive B_run. The repository-repair result evaluates a different, unconstrained skills-form AR protocol and cannot validate A3's evidence-cited conditional critic.
adversarial_verifications.concrete_falsification: The superiority claim is presently falsified as an evidence claim: the closest naive critic result is worse than a single reviewer, while the structured result lacks the relevant baseline—existing Evidence Gate plus counter-review—and the project has no measured marginal-utility or error-correlation data. A3 should therefore not be advanced as a better verifier; at most, its typed evidence/concern dispositions can be tested as contract hardening within the existing gate.
transfer_limits: SWE-PRBench measures overlap with human PR comments through an LLM judge, not correctness of canonical risk findings, severity, provenance, or runtime-confirmed state transitions.
SWE-bench Verified measures final patch test passage; this project stops before automatic patching and already separates hypotheses, deterministic facts, RuntimeEvidence, and state promotion.
The structured evidence constraint was tested only on SWE-PRBench, not on the 500-case SWE-bench Verified run cited for pass-rate and token cost.
The paper uses one backbone and does not estimate correlated error, conditional independence, critic calibration, false-retraction rate, or unique-counterevidence yield.
The reported approximately 4.5× token multiplier belongs to full AR versus zero-shot, not to one selective critic call; selective trigger prevalence and reviewer-response cost remain unknown.
The local system is still a design with unmeasured project outcomes, so neither the current gate nor A3 has demonstrated operating performance.
required_constraints: Keep deterministic Evidence Gate checks and state promotion as final authority; the critic must never create a finding, raise severity, or set runtime_confirmed.

Implement typed disagreement inside the existing gate rather than introducing a second generic verifier: reject/abstain/request-probe only, with finding/contributor IDs plus exact evidence IDs and source locators.

Run at most one fresh-context challenge only for pre-registered High/Critical conflict, unresolved counterevidence, runtime/static disagreement, test-intent mismatch, or profiler-causality ambiguity; no iterative agreement loop.

Require a frozen independent verdict before exposing the existing finding when the task permits, and explicitly test same-backbone versus different-backbone error overlap before claiming independence.
Charge every critic/reviewer-response token to inclusive B_run and compare against an equal-token merger self-review; report natural cost separately.

Preserve challenged findings and critic dispositions in lineage history, and have blind evaluator adjudication label valid counterevidence, false retractions, duplicate concerns, and critic-caused misses.
adversarial_verifications.decisive_experiment: Run one pre-registered, case-clustered, same-B_run paired verifier experiment on evaluator-adjudicated High/Critical/conflict cases plus matched non-trigger controls: (1) current Evidence Gate with its existing counter-review, (2) gate plus equal-token merger self-review, (3) gate plus selective typed fresh-context critic using the same backbone, and (4) the same critic using a genuinely different backbone if available. Freeze evidence snapshots, model/prompt versions, triggers, and critic budget. Primary endpoint is unique valid counterevidence or severity correction not already produced by the gate, accompanied by lower unsupported/wrong-severity findings; safety endpoints are Critical/High Recall and critic-caused false retractions; efficiency is accepted true findings per token. Measure gate-miss/critic-miss overlap and phi/error correlation. Kill A3 if it fails to improve over both gate-only and equal-token self-review (clustered CI includes no benefit), produces any critic-attributable Critical miss or exceeds the pre-registered 2-point Recall margin, or has no accepted-TP-per-token Pareto gain. A win would justify only a selective pilot, not proof.
adversarial_verifications.critical_gap: No evidence currently measures A3's incremental information over the exact existing Evidence Gate. In particular, there are no paired project labels for unique counterevidence, duplicate concerns, gate/critic joint-error cells, false retractions, trigger prevalence, or budget displacement. Without that matrix, 'independent semantic critic' is a role description, not demonstrated independent verification.

strongest_evidence: The closest positive primary study, Balestra et al., “Improving Dynamic Specification Inference with LLM-Generated Counterexamples” (2026-04-12, https://arxiv.org/html/2604.10761v1), evaluated 43 Java methods and formal SpecFuzzer postconditions. GPT-5.1 counterexamples raised mean specification precision from 67.83% to 74.17%, but the model’s own invalid-postcondition verdict had only 55% precision; recall stayed unchanged only because the workflow could remove assertions but never add them. This supports execution-certified falsification of universal assertions, not general confirmation/refutation of Python code-review findings.

c-CRAB (2026-03-24, https://arxiv.org/html/2603.23448v1) is closer to code review, but its oracle originates in human review and a known before/after change. Tests are retained only after fail-before/pass-after execution, up to three execution-guided generation attempts, environment construction, and coding-agent validation. Its funnel falls from 410 PRs/595 comments at environment construction to 184 PRs/234 tests after validation. It demonstrates expensive benchmark curation, not that a review agent can author an independent operational oracle for its own finding.

REAP v4 (2026-07-28, https://arxiv.org/html/2604.01527v4) does not generate probes: it retrieves production tests, removes solution-diff leakage, applies code-path relevance filtering, then performs repeated pre-change execution and transient-failure filtering. Its safeguards support treating generated probes as untrusted candidates and show the required policy cost; they do not establish probe effectiveness or oracle independence.

“Beyond Test Presence” (2026-07-13, https://arxiv.org/html/2607.12068v1) reports a higher flakiness-candidate rate for agent-generated Python test files than human files (0.41 vs 0.30), but this headline is based primarily on static smell proxies and the paper acknowledges construct limits. It is a warning, not a transferable project threshold.

The local pipeline currently exact-matches an approved command manifest and records RuntimeEvidence; it has no generated-code, oracle, relevance, leak-check, or overlay-validation contract (docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md §9–11). A4 therefore adds a material executable-code security and evaluation surface rather than merely extending one schema.
adversarial_verifications.source_entailment: Primary evidence entails a narrow proposition: an LLM can sometimes synthesize an executable witness that falsifies a formal, universally quantified assertion, and such a witness can be accepted after deterministic execution. It does not entail that the same-model probe supplies an independent expected result, that a passing probe refutes an existential/probabilistic concurrency or performance claim, or that probe outcomes safely confirm arbitrary Python 3.14 code-review findings. c-CRAB’s transfer additionally depends on human intent plus known pre/post states; REAP depends on pre-existing production tests. Thus A4’s broad confirm/refute claim fails entailment, while a candidate-only falsification pilot remains plausible.
adversarial_verifications.concrete_falsification: Use the finding “there exists an interleaving in which two concurrent calls emit the side effect twice.” An LLM creates a pytest that exercises one benign fixed schedule three times, observes one emission each time, and declares `refutes_if=all runs pass`. Target-path relevance, clean execution, and stability can all pass, yet the result cannot refute an existential race because the bad interleaving was never explored. This is a concrete logically invalid rejection that the current A4 schema permits unless claim quantifier and scheduler coverage are explicit.
transfer_limits: The strongest counterexample result is Java method-level dynamic specification inference over formal postconditions, not repository-level Python 3.14 quality, async, concurrency, or performance diagnosis.

Specification inference accepts a concrete violating execution as a sound falsifier of a universal assertion; arbitrary review findings have existential, universal, probabilistic, normative, and severity claims with different evidence semantics.

c-CRAB derives intent from human reviews and validates against known before/after repository states. At live review time A4 normally has neither a trusted fixed commit nor an authoritative human oracle.
REAP validates retrieved tests from one proprietary monorepo; it neither generates tests nor shows that generator and oracle can be safely combined.
The reported agent-test flakiness difference is a static candidate/smell measure, not dynamically confirmed flakiness transferable as an acceptance threshold.

A passing generated test establishes only one observed execution. It cannot generally confirm intended correctness or refute an existential race, workload-dependent performance regression, or unvisited error path.

Test generation is in the research brief and adjacent to the proposal’s focused-test objective, so it is not categorical product-scope expansion. However, generated executable source, overlay lifecycle, import/fixture controls, leak auditing, and oracle adjudication materially expand the current exact-command executor and make the “minimal change” characterization untenable.
required_constraints: Downgrade A4 from general confirm/refute evidence to an offline, feature-flagged, candidate-only falsification pilot; a surviving result is pilot-worthiness only.

Require a typed claim quantifier and evidence rule before generation. A witness may falsify a universal behavioral assertion or support an existential behavior claim; absence of a witness must never refute an existential/probabilistic claim.

The expected result must come from versioned `user_observation`, authoritative `doc_contract`, evaluator-owned specification/test, or another generator-independent oracle. The finding text, current implementation, and generator’s own expectation are not independent oracles.

With no independent oracle, a probe may only produce a concrete execution artifact for human review, retract a claim when logically sound, or leave it abstained/inconclusive; it must never create `runtime_confirmed`.

Generator, executor, reviewer, and evaluator/gold namespaces must be separated. Generated probes must never become repository tests, gold, hidden scorer input, or final-holdout feedback automatically.

Use a read-only source snapshot plus disposable overlay/container, exact allowlisted pytest command, no network/secrets/evaluator paths, import and fixture allowlists, resource/time limits, reset, raw logs, and complete policy/source/probe/model/prompt hashes.

Require target-path causal relevance, collection success, repeated clean-run stability, side-effect cleanup, and leak audit. Any instability, timeout, policy violation, or hidden-artifact access is inconclusive and disables promotion.

For offline validation, require fail on the frozen buggy state, pass on the evaluator-known fixed state, and reject at least one adversarial wrong patch; the generator must not see the fixed diff, hidden tests, or labels.

Limit eligibility to one High/Critical, testable correctness/concurrency claim lacking a relevant existing test; one file, one test, one bounded repair. Exclude performance claims unless a separate representative workload/oracle contract exists.

Charge generation, sandbox startup/reset, repeated runs, validation, and human oracle adjudication to the same inclusive B_run/tool-second budget; compare against existing-test-only and abstain, not against a cheaper baseline with omitted safety costs.
adversarial_verifications.decisive_experiment: Pre-register one paired, evaluator-owned `P4` versus `P4+A4` experiment on Python buggy/fixed/adversarial-wrong-patch triples, restricted to High/Critical findings with no relevant existing test. The generator sees only the buggy snapshot, typed finding, and allowed authoritative oracle provenance; it never sees labels, fixes, hidden tests, or final/OOD artifacts. Blind experts label claim quantifier, oracle independence, relevance, and final disposition. Run every admitted probe in fresh sandboxes repeatedly, including controlled async schedule perturbations, and measure unique correct confirmation/retraction, false confirmation/rejection, stability, policy/leak violations, total tool seconds, and accepted true findings per cost under identical inclusive B_run. Kill A4—not merely tune it—if there is any false `runtime_confirmed`, logically invalid rejection, independent-oracle or hidden-access violation, unstable admitted probe, Critical/High regression, or if the paired precision/false-positive improvement CI includes zero after full safety and adjudication cost.
adversarial_verifications.critical_gap: No admissible source reports the joint quantity A4 needs on this project distribution: the fraction of Python 3.14 review findings that have a genuinely independent oracle and valid claim quantifier, multiplied by generated-probe relevance/collection/stability yield, minus false confirmation/rejection and full sandbox/human-adjudication cost. External results mostly concern formal specification filtering, benchmark curation, repair, or static test-quality proxies; none establishes diagnosis-only Precision/Recall transfer for Python async/performance review.

strongest_evidence: PerfAgent (arXiv:2607.19653v1, §§III-A–D, IV-C, VI) shows that profiler/test feedback can improve an iterative patch optimizer, but its treatment repeatedly edits, rebuilds, tests, and re-profiles for up to five turns. Its component ablation compares LLM optimization loops; it never compares a diagnosis-only post-runtime LLM call with deterministic RuntimeEvidence normalization, lifecycle mapping, Evidence Gate, and composition. The authors also limit transfer because results use single workloads, about a dozen Python-centric repositories, two models, one harness, and single runs: https://arxiv.org/html/2607.19653v1

SWE-Adept (arXiv:2603.01327v1, §§3.3, 5.2) lets a repair agent expand plans after test feedback, but this is embedded in code-edit/checkpoint/branch workflows. Its ablation removes the entire specialized resolution module, not the marginal feedback-conditioned re-analysis call; token use is also far above this project's bounded diagnosis setting: https://arxiv.org/html/2603.01327v1

The local design already deterministically maps `completed/supports` to `runtime_confirmed` and `completed/refutes` to `rejected`, then performs causal/counterexample checks—including whether a hotspot is root cause or merely an upstream caller and whether the workload is representative—and finally composes impact, limitations, and action (`docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md`, §§9–12; `docs/ai-selection-matrix/04-agent-orchestration-adr.md`, §§4–7). D3 therefore overlaps the state mapper, existing Evidence Gate, and composer for many cases.

The shortlist evidence itself labels A5's expected effect `[INFERENCE]` (`09-ai-advancement-review-artifacts.json#/track_summaries`, primary-frontier candidate `RuntimeEvidence 후 affected-perspective 1회 재분석`), and the systems track explicitly lists as unknown whether post-runtime LLM re-analysis beats deterministic state mapping plus human-readable composition (systems track unknowns).

The current test request binds only `finding_id`, policy, command, and state-change class; it does not freeze the tested hypothesis, predicted supporting/refuting observations, oracle basis, or target path (`docs/evidence/03-ai-pipeline-technical-design.md`, lines 220–232; confirmed again as ACT-C4 at track-results lines 2659–2677). That missing entailment binding makes a post-result rewrite unsafe.
adversarial_verifications.source_entailment: The cited primary sources support the broad proposition that runtime feedback can help an LLM continue an autonomous patching/optimization trajectory. They do not entail A5's narrower mechanism or its marginal value in this project: neither source evaluates one affected-perspective diagnosis revision over an otherwise identical deterministic normalizer/lifecycle gate/composer. PerfAgent's gains combine profiler summarization, repeated patch generation, selective tests, re-profiling, and best-patch selection; SWE-Adept combines adaptive planning with editing and checkpointed version control. Transfer to an immutable-evidence, diagnosis-only successor/tombstone update is therefore an unsupported extrapolation.
adversarial_verifications.concrete_falsification: Suppose a focused concurrent test for a High `sync_io_in_async` finding completes with an independent oracle and `result=refutes` because a reachable guard prevents the alleged synchronous call. The deterministic baseline must reject that hypothesis. If D3 changes the same lineage to `cache_lock_contention`, retains High/active status, or cites the old refuting RuntimeEvidence as support for the rewritten claim, it has reinterpreted away a contradiction. The current schema cannot reliably prevent this because the executed request did not hash-lock the original claim, preconditions, predicted observations, oracle, root-cause category, and target location.
transfer_limits: Source tasks are autonomous code repair/optimization, whereas this project stops before patching and must report diagnostic truth.
PerfAgent's useful feedback is entangled with up to five edit–measure iterations and best-patch selection; A5 permits one immutable-source re-analysis and cannot inherit that causal result.
Neither study includes the relevant control: deterministic normalized evidence plus fixed lifecycle mapping, existing semantic gate, and composer without the extra analyst call.
PerfAgent measures single supplied workloads and reports single-run results on one base harness; the paper expressly warns that workload-specific speedups may not generalize.
SWE-Adept's ablation is module-level and cannot attribute gains to feedback-conditioned reinterpretation; its large repair trajectories do not establish cost-effectiveness inside inclusive `B_run`.

Binary focused-test support/refutation is already consumed deterministically; profiler causal ambiguity is already examined by the Evidence Gate. Calling D3 for every completed runtime result duplicates work unless a narrower ambiguity trigger is demonstrated.
required_constraints: Before execution, freeze a `HypothesisContract` containing claim/root-cause/location, preconditions, action, expected support and refute observations, independent oracle basis, workload, and hashes; RuntimeEvidence must bind to that exact contract.

Apply deterministic lifecycle mapping first. A `completed/refutes` result irreversibly rejects the tested hypothesis; D3 may not promote it, preserve it as active, raise severity, or relabel the result.

Any change to claim, root-cause category, primary location, preconditions, or oracle creates a new hypothesis/finding ID. It cannot inherit the predecessor's runtime-confirmed status or use its RuntimeEvidence as support.
Make D3 asymmetric and non-promotive: it may retract, downgrade, add a limitation/counterevidence, or abstain. A new causal explanation remains a hypothesis requiring new evidence.

Do not invoke D3 for deterministic test outcomes. If retained at all, trigger only on an enumerated completed-profiler ambiguity that normalization and the existing gate cannot resolve; blocked/failed/inconclusive outcomes remain deterministic abstentions.

Require citations to immutable normalized rows and counterevidence, plus an entailment check between each revised sentence and the frozen hypothesis/evidence IDs. Preserve the original contributor and contradiction in the final report history.

Charge the call to the same inclusive `B_run`, expose tokens/latency/call count, and compare against an equal-budget baseline; do not treat the existing runtime tool's value as evidence for the extra LLM call.
adversarial_verifications.decisive_experiment: Run a preregistered paired `P4-Normalized` versus `P4-Normalized+D3` ablation using identical frozen code, identical test/profile raw outputs, identical normalized RuntimeEvidence, the same model, and the same inclusive `B_run`; stratify blinded gold cases into clear test support/refute, ambiguous multi-hotspot profiles, and misleading/non-representative workloads. Blind evaluators score exact root-cause leaf, severity, disposition, unsupported causal claims, contradiction-laundering, accepted true findings per 1k tokens, and reviewer decision time. Kill A5 if the one-sided 95% CI upper bound for improvement in joint root-cause-plus-severity accuracy is below a preregistered +5 percentage-point minimum, if accepted true findings per cost does not improve, or if even one revision overrides a frozen refutation/status invariant.
adversarial_verifications.critical_gap: There is no direct marginal-utility evidence for the extra call, and the current request/evidence schema does not bind RuntimeEvidence to a frozen falsifiable hypothesis strongly enough to distinguish legitimate explanation refinement from post-hoc contradiction laundering.

disposition_change_rule: Raw track decisions are leads preserved at each track_summaries[].raw_result_uri. Final disposition follows E-08 decision-changing claims, source entailment, transfer risk, same-B_run measurability, and candidate-specific adversarial verification; disagreements remain in raw track artifacts.
artifact_note: Track summaries preserve strategy, candidate dispositions, source locators, and raw-result hashes. Decision-changing claims are normalized in E-08; raw track prose is intentionally omitted so unverified leads are not mistaken for adopted claims.

A1.gold: frozen evaluator-owned defects and necessary-perspective multi-labels; fixed-five output is candidate only
arms: S1 planner shadow with fixed-five execution
S2 deterministic mandatory plus planner optional routing
A1.operational_budget: F5 and S2 use identical inclusive B_run; evaluator-only shadow cost is separate and never fed back
gates: analyst calls or I/O tokens reduced >=20%
A1.failure_decision: keep fixed-five and do not promote S2

A3.unit: High/Critical, conflict, or unresolved-counterevidence finding batch with matched non-trigger controls, clustered by case/repository
A3.blind_access: all arms hidden from gold labels; evaluator adjudicates shuffled outputs; no independently lockable gold -> excluded or inconclusive
A3.operational_budget: same evidence snapshot and inclusive B_run; evaluator gold/adjudication cost separate and not fed back
A3.incremental_valid_counterevidence: valid counterevidence in critic arm absent from gate-only arm
gates: incremental valid counterevidence and valid severity corrections exceed both gate-only and equal-token self-review with repository-cluster 95% CI lower bound >0
A3.failure_decision: remove separate critic; retain typed disagreement only inside current Evidence Gate

A4.unit: evaluator-owned finding-level buggy/fixed/adversarial-wrong-patch triple, clustered by case/repository
A4.blind_access: generator sees buggy snapshot and allowed oracle provenance only; no fixed diff, hidden test, labels, or final holdout
A4.operational_budget: generation, sandbox startup/reset, execution/repeat, automated validation in same B_run and tool-second budget; human gold/oracle adjudication separate and not fed back
gates: accepted finding precision improvement or false-positive reduction versus P4-F5 with repository-cluster 95% CI excluding 0 in favorable direction
zero Critical/High Recall loss and false confirmation/rejection
A4.failure_decision: do not promote A4; retain existing-test-only P4-F5 or abstain

one primary hypothesis per experiment; Holm if multiple primary claims
